France

For a movie that aligns with your nostalgic mood and appreciation for Hitchcock and Kubrick, I recommend "Rear Window" (1954). Directed by Alfred Hitchcock, this psychological thriller is a masterpiece of suspense and mystery from the Golden Age of Hollywood. It features a wheelchair-bound photographer who spies on his neighbors and becomes convinced one of them has committed murder. The film’s tight narrative, visual storytelling, and psychological depth make it a perfect fit for fans of classic cinema.
